visual.general_description: Black-and-white flow diagram of myocardial ischemia outcomes: necrosis, stunning and hibernation.
visual.detailed_description: Flow diagram titled Myocardial Ischemia with three branches. Left: an arrow labeled Severe and prolonged leads to a boxed Myocardial necrosis, then No return of contractile function. Middle: an arrow to Reperfusion- relief of ischemia before necrosis occurs, then a boxed Stunned myocardium (transient post-ischemic dysfunction), then Recovery of function (days to weeks). Right: an arrow to Chronic low flow, then a boxed Hibernating myocardium contractile abnormalities, viability, de-differentiated cells; ellipses labeled Repetitive episodes of stunning and Metabolic adaptation feed this box from the stunned myocardium and the chronic-flow arrow, and an arrow labeled Revascularization leads to Eventual recovery of function (can take weeks to months for contractile apparatus to reform).
